name: Ninsun
subtitle: Mistress of Dreams
description: This hero story is yet to be revealed.
lore: Ninsun is symbolically mother to Ekur’s rulers, and literally mother of roughly a dozen gods, as well as the great hero Gilgamesh. She interprets dreams and omens for her children and for the Realm’s mortal sovereigns, and intercedes with other gods on their behalf. Recently, however, prayers and petitions have gone unanswered, as if Ninsun were suddenly distracted or unavailable…
